question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
The cost per kg of gain in the control group was 210.00 and in T1 was 169.94. 

To find the percentage, we can use the formula: 

((Control - T1) / Control) * 100 

Plugging in the values, we get:

((210.00 - 169.94) / 210.00) * 100
= (40.06 / 210.00) * 100
= 0.191 * 100
= 19.1%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.1% lower than in the control group.
